decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork system anchored in the firm's core engineering and modular platform, it is likely to be improved and retained unless demand has stayed clearly below expectations.
The automated concrete distributor flow control draws on the firm's automation know-how and in-house R&D, so management would usually keep it to refine and integrate into broader factory solutions.

The shuttering magnet block is closely related to the established formwork business, though its lower prominence and component-like role create some rationalisation risk despite the strong knowledge fit.
This magnetic formwork component had standalone presentation and fits accumulated know-how in formwork accessories, making continued commercial learning more attractive than withdrawal.

Given its weaker prominence, likely overlap with other magnetic formwork items, and the firm's demonstrated willingness to prune adjacent products as with Product D, management would reallocate resources away from it.
